# Oak Ridge Associated Universities (ORAU)

> ORAU is a consortium of 170+ Ph.D.-granting universities advancing scientific research, workforce development, and STEM education through partnerships with national laboratories and federal agencies.

Founded in 1946, ORAU operates as a unique consortium-based organization managing research partnerships, educational programs, and professional development initiatives. The organization provides contract vehicles and workforce solutions while maintaining a strong focus on health physics, radiation safety training, and emerging technologies like AI and biotechnology convergence.
